Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises


In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.


ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.


Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.


About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.


Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.
  • Leadership : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.
  • Planning & Coordination : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.
  • Communication : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.
  • Safety & Quality : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.


What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.
